name: amnesia-repo
description: Build/tooling manifest for the amnesia repo. Not published. It exists for `npm test` (node:test, no dependencies) and the fuzz targets (npm run fuzz, ClusterFuzzLite), which resolve Jazzer.js. The site is static (src/), the API gate is a zero-dependency Cloudflare Worker (worker/), and the self-host image is image/.
